purpose: Roger's terminalization-window directive: any src change must be recorded as image-input drift for the single final republish after the terminalization wave. This record names every worker image-input path that has diverged from the published image's freeze SHA, and what diverged it.

driftedPaths.package.json: terminalization verifiers/checks wired into the npm test chain, including the component-deferral runtime verifier and its mutations, the lane-C dependency verifier, and the lane-B exact-deferral recognition verifier and its mutations
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap-engine/evaluator.ts: structural automatic/no-filing clamp: routeIsAutomaticOrNoFiling veto in isCourtFiledPetitionRoute, pre-route and post-route guidance backstops, paymentAllowed clamp (lane-B MI rule-11 defect class)
57 decision rules across 15 profiles (AK, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, IL, MA, MD, MI, NE, NY, SD, UT, VA) whose candidates are all automatic/no-filing corrected from packet_ready_with_caution/show_cautions_then_allow_packet_checkout to guidance_only/save_state_guidance_no_checkout
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap/documents/packet-route-reso: guidance_only resolutions carry guidanceTrackIds from the lane-B registry; new component_deferral route kind resolved from the exact trackId with priority over the LEGACY_VERIFIED jurisdictions; sellable/creditConsumable remain false; new exact_supported_deferral route kind resolved by track id or compiled pathway, with priority over the LEGACY_VERIFIED jurisdictions
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap/documents/guidance-packet-r: fail-closed runtime registry for lane-B complete-guidance treatments, extended with the closed component-deferral loader (10 composed routes, 31 components) and the localized participant bundle builder; extended again with the lane-B exact-supported-deferral loader, its pathway index (multi-claimant pathways fail closed rather than asserting one treatment) and the participant bundle builder
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap-engine/component-deferral-c: new: the single component-deferral clamp applied at both server engine adapters (evaluator.ts left byte-identical to the pinned parity approval); also clamps exact supported deferrals matched on the compiled pathway
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap-engine/composed-route-selec: new: the single server-owned composed-route selector and the forbidden client route-identity field list
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap-engine/contracts.ts: server-only selectedTrackId on the request; treatmentClassification, selectedTrackId and deferralComponentIds on the evaluation; treatmentClassification widened to exact_supported_deferral
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/screening-session: new: re-derives server-authored route identity from the saved screening session inputs
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/eligibility-adapt: component-deferral clamp on the consumer shape: guidance_only, paymentAllowed false, no priceCents, localized treatment carried; same clamp for exact supported deferrals
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/types.ts: server-authored component-deferral metadata on the result, Briefcase item and create input (persisted in the existing artifact_refs_json column; no migration); treatmentClassification widened to exact_supported_deferral
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/save-result-polic: component deferral forces paymentAllowed false for sponsored and direct sessions alike, guidance_saved, guidance_packet, not_applicable, metadata into artifactRefs
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/briefcase.ts: single-write-path component-deferral clamp; localized summary/next steps from the registry; metadata re-surfaced on read; exact-deferral clamp preserving the full bilingual treatment
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/payment-adapter.t: independent component-deferral denial in assertCheckoutAllowed and the payment placeholder, before already-paid handling; independent exact-deferral denial by track id and by pathway
driftedPaths.src/lib/expungement-ai/consumer-render-r: passes exact track identity so a deferred route returns route_not_renderable before any packet row, payment check or enqueue
driftedPaths.src/lib/rcap/render/job-contract.ts: accepts the authoritative trackId and returns spec=null for component_deferral; spec=null for exact supported deferrals
driftedPaths.src/app/api/expungement-ai/evaluate/rout: rejects client-supplied route identity; server-side composed-route selection; fail-closed guidance when identity is unavailable
driftedPaths.src/app/api/expungement-ai/screening/sav: rejects client-supplied route identity; re-derives session route identity; 409 on mismatch; registry bundle replaces client payment, packet type, summary and next steps
driftedPaths.src/app/api/expungement-ai/checkout/rout: 403 for component_deferral after ownership resolution and before sponsored/payment handling; 403 for exact supported deferrals before sponsored handling
driftedPaths.scripts/lib: the terminalization generator now imports the authoritative packet-route resolver through the TypeScript ESM loader, so a deferral treatment is checked against real runtime behaviour rather than a copy of its rules

republishPlan: One final republish after the terminalization wave: new freeze SHA, new image-input fingerprint base, new GHCR digest, and a rerun of the F1 ephemeral staging regression against the new digest. No interim image is published from a drifted tree.
